# Jengara

Jengara is an AI software company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Jengara Labs is its AI product development arm, building a portfolio of products for distinct customer needs. Ribyos is its first featured product, an enterprise agent platform in development. Jengara Advisory is a supporting practice offering independent strategy, transformation and diligence expertise.

Contact: hello@jengara.ai
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

## Key facts

- Independent advisory. Recommendations are never tied to software, cloud or equipment resale.
- Two practices: Jengara Labs (Ribyos and product development) and Jengara Advisory (independent executive counsel, diligence and transformation leadership).
- Senior led. Expertise grounded in more than 15 years across global technology platforms and infrastructure.
- Serves enterprise leaders, boards and investors.
- Publishes evidence first research on AI economics, infrastructure and diligence at https://jengara.ai/insights/.

## Ribyos by Jengara Labs

Ribyos is an industry-neutral enterprise agent platform in development at Jengara Labs. Studio supports building and testing agents; Enterprise provides workspace governance; Marketplace is planned for reusable agents, connectors and workflow packs. Reliability and SRE are optional industry extensions. Open refers to interoperability and model choice, not an open-source licence.

- Product overview: https://jengara.ai/ribyos/

## Jengara Labs

The home of Jengara’s AI product portfolio, supported by applied research. Each product has its own audience and roadmap; Labs is not limited to enterprise software. Ribyos is the first featured product. https://jengara.ai/labs/

## Frequently asked questions

- What does Jengara do? Jengara develops AI products through Labs, including the enterprise platform Ribyos, and offers independent expertise through Advisory.
- Where is Jengara based? Amsterdam, Netherlands.
- How is Jengara structured? Labs leads product development, with Ribyos as the flagship platform. Advisory supports independent strategy, transformation and diligence engagements.
- Is Jengara independent? Yes. Recommendations are not tied to software, cloud or equipment resale.
- How can I contact Jengara? Email hello@jengara.ai or use https://jengara.ai/contact/.
